docs.siteAddress: Ground Floor, Arabian Center, Al Khawaneej St, Al Mizhar 1, Dubai, UAE
docs.subject: Door monitoring system with Oxygen IoT – 9 doors, Arabian Center

items.name: Oxygen IoT Smart Gateway
items.desc: Central hub for the door sensors, Zigbee + Wi-Fi/LAN, cloud link for app alerts

items.name: Oxygen IoT Door / Window Sensor
items.desc: Wireless magnetic door contact, open/close status and instant alerts, battery operated · 1 per door

items.name: Oxygen IoT Zigbee Signal Repeater
items.desc: Extends wireless coverage to doors far from the gateway

items.name: Oxygen IoT Smart Siren
items.desc: Local audible/visual alarm on door forced open or held open

items.name: Door Sensor Mounting Kit
items.desc: Spacer brackets and fixings for metal / fire-exit doors · 1 per door

items.name: Door Sensor Installation
items.desc: Fixing, alignment, pairing and testing · per door

items.name: Door Monitoring Dashboard & Alerts Setup
items.desc: Door naming, live open/closed status, door-held-open and after-hours alarms, push notifications to management mobiles, open/close history log

items.name: Testing, Handover & Training
items.desc: System test of all 9 doors, user app training and handover

docs.notes:
Wireless door monitoring for 9 doors: live open/closed status, instant mobile alerts, door-held-open and after-hours alarms, local siren and full open/close history.
Sensors are battery operated (typical battery life 1–2 years).
docs.terms:
Prices are valid for 15 days from the quotation date.
Payment: 50% advance with LPO, balance on completion.
Delivery & installation: 1 week from LPO.
Warranty: 1 year on equipment and workmanship.
Exclusions: cabling of any kind, power points, internet connection / network port for the gateway, civil works and mall permits.
Cloud alerts and app support included for the first year.
